stem_en: Given below are two statements : Statement I : Fatty acids and glycerols cannot be absorbed into the blood. Statement II : Specialized lymphatic capillaries called lacteals carry chylomicrons into lymphatic vessels and ultimately into the blood. In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

statements.label: I
statements.text: Fatty acids and glycerols cannot be absorbed into the blood.

statements.label: II
statements.text: Specialized lymphatic capillaries called lacteals carry chylomicrons into lymphatic vessels and ultimately into the blood.

options_en.1: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options_en.2: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options_en.3: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
options_en.4: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
